description.zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the live stream application. The AppName you enter must be the same as the AppName of the live stream to be relayed for the configuration to take effect. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
转推的第三方直播地址，最多支持添加1个地址。

>目标地址协议必须和转推的直播流协议一致，目前仅支持RTMP和SRT协议的转推地址。
description.en:
The third-party live streaming address for relay. You can add up to one address.

>The protocol of the destination address must be the same as the protocol of the live stream to be relayed. Only RTMP and SRT relay addresses are supported.

description.zh:
转推结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

>结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end time of the relay. The date format follows the ISO 8601 notation and uses UTC+0 time. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

>The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
转推开始时间。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en: The start time of the relay. The date format follows the ISO 8601 notation and uses UTC+0 time. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
转推有效时间。取值：

- **always**：永久生效。

- **time**：指定时间内有效。

>取值为**time**时，**StartTime**和**EndTime**必填。
description.en:
The validity period of the relay. Valid values:

- **always**: permanently effective.

- **time**: effective within the specified time period.

>If the value is **time**, **StartTime** and **EndTime** are required.

title.zh: 添加直播中心转推配置
title.en: Add live center stream relay configuration

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The single-user QPS limit of this API is 100 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please make calls appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testapp --stream-name teststream --dst-url rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2 --transfer-args always --start-time 2017-12-21T10:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddLiveCenterTransfer --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName teststream --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TransferArgs always --StartTime '2017-12-21T10:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DstUrl 'rtmp://push.example2.aliyunlive.com/testapp1/teststream2' --AppName testapp
